description: This PHP class 'LDAPSyncStatusModel' serves as a data model for LDAP synchronization status information within the OrangeHRM system. It implements serialization and normalization functionalities, and it maps entity data from 'LDAPSyncStatus' to API response schema, including timestamps and status.

classes.name: LDAPSyncStatusModel
classes.description: A model representing LDAP synchronization status, including start/end timestamps and status, suitable for API serialization within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an LDAPSyncStatus entity and sets up filtering and attribute mappings for serialization.
